dialogues.speaker: Iliana
dialogues.text: Please mind the distance between the platform and the train! And please be careful with your belongings... Do not drop anything into the gap...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happens if something falls in?

dialogues.speaker: Iliana
dialogues.text: That would be a problem. Best case, we would have to retrieve it before the train departs...

dialogues.speaker: Iliana
dialogues.text: I'm a newly appointed Transport Bureau Safety Officer. My job is to ensure that every train can operate safely.

dialogues.speaker: Iliana
dialogues.text: But I've just taken up the post, so there is still a great deal for me to learn!

dialogues.speaker: Iliana
dialogues.text: Goodbye. And please be careful with your belongings!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if I can't get it out?

dialogues.speaker: Iliana
dialogues.text: Then you'll have to hope that the item does not get damaged as the train leaves the station... If it is damaged, the passenger will have to bear the loss themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Iliana
dialogues.text: If it's not damaged, Transport Bureau staff will help retrieve it from beside the tracks.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You go down there to get it?

dialogues.speaker: Iliana
dialogues.text: Of course. We can't ask the passengers to climb down there themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Iliana
dialogues.text: Making sure passengers can safely get back their belongings is part of a safety officer's duty, after all.
